title: Robinson Crusoe – level 2
paragraphs: Do you want to learn English effectively? We have a special book for you. The book is in three levels. You can learn English for your level when you read this book.
Level 1 is in the present tense. Level 2 is in the past tense. Level 3 is in grammar which is important for intermediate students.
The name of the book is Robinson Crusoe. You can find the book at www.robinsoncrusoeinlevels.com.
You can read one chapter every day. You can learn 1530 new words. You can learn grammar important for your level.
We hope you will enjoy the book.
